September 2025 through August 2026. Recorded CHF 463471.492303746700; comparable-price imputation CHF 5742.499944450603; coverage partial. Unresolved charges remain outside the modeled subtotal.
Formula: sum included original-currency line amounts × matched month/currency CHF-per-unit FX, plus separately modeled missing-amount charges. CHF uses 1. Credits keep their sign. Count each source charge once. Exact eligible Azure/AWS priced mirrors recover a missing amount inside recorded CHF. Missing metered costs require positive usage with resource, unit and FX. Imputed CHF = missing quantity × median of at least 3 positive same-source, resource, month, unit, currency and charge-type original-currency unit prices × FX. Missing FX, unsupported prices, unresolved duplicates, drafts and review lines receive no imputed amount. Annual billing does not multiply monthly contract rows. The recorded subtotal is the observed coverage reference. Lower and upper cost cells are blank because the model publishes no cost range.

Estimated facility energy; coverage partial
Formula: sum monthly supported activity × scenario IT intensity × PUE for IT-side workloads, plus facility estimates for tokens and messages. Azure/AWS/hoster metered units include vCPU-hours, vCore-hours, runner minutes ÷ 60, GPU-hours, node-hours and GB-days when compatible. The data platform's dp-dev and dp-prod observed node-hours replace corresponding Azure node-hour activity to prevent double counting. Gateway units = (input + output tokens) ÷ 1,000. Cached input is already included in input. Final subscription messages are a separate activity stream. Missing or unresolved activity stays unknown. M365 storage, billed Power BI capacity-days and network GB are planning quantities excluded from the official energy total. Generic SaaS electricity, unlinked servers and unsupported units have no credit.

calculation_or_assumption:
Location-based estimate in kg CO2e. Includes Swiss operating emissions and mixed-EU AI generation proxies. Coverage partial
Formula: sum supported facility kWh × the applicable location factor for the same scenario at each workload boundary. Frankfurt uses Germany consumption CO2, Dublin uses Ireland consumption CO2, Zurich uses Swiss consumption operating CO2e including imports, and mixed-EU AI text loads use the EEA generation CO2e proxy. The organizer header says CO2. The mixed calculation is reported as kg CO2e. Unknown locations, missing activity and unsupported conversions stay outside the subtotal. The Swiss lifecycle series, market-based certificates and planning-only network/capacity estimates are excluded.
Mid by reported location: Germany: 37234.080000000000 kWh, 12287.246400000000 kg CO2e (0 energy and 0 emissions buckets unquantified); Ireland: 4708.969839047160 kWh, 931.434234163530 kg CO2e (0 energy and 0 emissions buckets unquantified); Mixed: 5317.621992480000 kWh, 949.058862772472 kg CO2e (744 energy and 744 emissions buckets unquantified); Switzerland: 80800.644640635360 kWh, 3959.231587391133 kg CO2e (36 energy and 36 emissions buckets unquantified). Bucket counts describe monthly reporting groups and cannot be interpreted as source records.
Mixed-EU grid low/mid/high = 0.160626870000/0.178474300000/0.196321730000 kg CO2e/kWh. 2025 estimated EU generation average with ±10% sensitivity for mixed EU AI workloads. Provider routing and country shares are unverified.

VSE slide 2: domestic plus imported operating emissions in 2024, provisional 2025 and 2022. Excludes upstream emissions. Used in the dashboard emissions estimate. | Source date 2026-02-25
Operating CO2e, including imports, per kWh consumed. Low/mid/high correspond to 2024, provisional 2025 and 2022. Treat these as year-based sensitivities. The separate lifecycle range 0.057/0.090/0.135 kg CO2e/kWh includes upstream emissions and serves as context. A strictly comparable direct-CO2 figure including imports is unresolved. Apply the operating series once to supported Zurich facility kWh.

UBA 2025 provisional domestic-consumption CO2, including electricity trade balance, 330 g/kWh. Use as a baseline-period proxy with a sensitivity of ±10%. | Source date 2026-03-01
Mid = 330 g ÷ 1,000 = 0.330 kg CO2/kWh; endpoints = mid × 0.90 or 1.10. Apply once to Frankfurt facility kWh.

SEAI 2025 provisional consumption factor, 197.8 g/kWh. Includes domestic losses. Emissions outside Ireland are excluded in the source. Sensitivity of ±10%. | Source date 2026-11-21
Mid = 197.8 g ÷ 1,000 = 0.1978 kg CO2/kWh; endpoints = mid × 0.90 or 1.10. Apply once to Dublin facility kWh.

Planning proxy for IT power, 2–10 W per allocated vCPU. The Dell server benchmark anchors the order of magnitude. Packing, server type and utilisation are unknown in the case. | Source date 2025-03-26
Formula: allocated vCPU-hours × assumed 2/5/10 W per vCPU ÷ 1,000 × PUE. A managed vCore uses the same proxy. Runner minutes ÷ 60 × assumed 2/4/8 vCPUs × corresponding vCPU rate × PUE.

Benchmark-anchored IT power scenarios for an unknown node. 164 W at idle and around 501 W at 40% benchmark load inform the sensitivity. Values are workload assumptions. | Source date 2025-03-26
Formula: observed or separately metered node-hours × assumed average node watts (164/350/650) ÷ 1,000 × PUE. Cluster node-hours are the energy quantity. Runtime and active hours determine pause eligibility.

IT power sensitivity based on an unknown accelerator profile. The H100 board rating ranges from 350–400 W PCIe to 700 W SXM. The scenario values represent assumed average power including an allocated share of a host, rather than measured device power. | Source date 2026-11-21
Formula: billed GPU-hours × assumed IT kW (0.15/0.40/0.70) × PUE. Monitoring utilisation is a safety signal. The billed GPU and monitored instance require a verified link before operational change.

5.4 W × 24 h ÷ 20,000 GB ÷ 1,000 W/kW is the disk-only floor. Mid and high use 3× and 10× for replicas, utilisation and storage-server overhead before facility PUE. | Source date 2021-11-01
Formula: compatible billed GB-days × disk floor 0.00000648 × overhead multiplier (1/3/10) × PUE. The disk-only floor uses decimal 20,000 GB. Plain GB transfer cannot be treated as GB-days.

Illustrative conversion of the published 0.24 Wh median Gemini text prompt assuming 500 input-plus-output tokens. The 0.25× and 5× endpoints reflect model and length sensitivity. The source already includes facility overhead. Cached tokens are counted only within input. | Source date 2025-08-21
Mid = 0.24 Wh ÷ 1,000 Wh per kWh × 1,000 ÷ assumed 500 tokens per prompt. Endpoints scale mid by 0.25 and 5. Apply to input plus output in blocks of 1,000. PUE already included.

Use the 0.24 Wh Gemini Apps median as a facility proxy for one text message. Scenario multipliers are assumptions for unknown providers and workloads. | Source date 2025-08-21
Mid = 0.24 Wh ÷ 1,000 Wh per kWh. Endpoints scale mid by 0.25 and 5. Multiply by Final subscription messages in each observation. PUE already included.

Google 2025 fleet PUE anchors the low scenario and its cited Uptime Institute survey anchors the high scenario. Mid is a planning assumption. Applies once to IT-only activity. | Source date 2026-11-21
Facility kWh = IT kWh × PUE (1.09/1.35/1.54). PUE is a facility-to-IT energy ratio.

calculation_or_assumption:
Direct attribution where supported. Leave ambiguous departments Unallocated, and retain pooled invoices at resource grain. Do not spread unknown balances across tenants. | Source date 2026-11-21
Use source tags and verified ownership, exact unique resource mapping when available, and the observed contract cost centre. Leave ambiguous ownership Unallocated. Keep pooled charges together. Project hours and FTE are diagnostic comparisons. Exact high-confidence server relationships support evidence; raw telemetry and suggested aliases cannot independently allocate invoices.
Dashboard scan: clusters require ≥14 valid distinct dates, ≥70% selected-day coverage and ≤20% active runtime. Server scan requires ≥3 complete weeks and ≥75% coverage, mean CPU ≤5%, highest weekly peak ≤20%, mean RAM ≤40% and mean uptime ≥120 h/week. Seat scan flags a positive purchased-minus-active gap in the latest valid Final month and notes whether it recurs in the prior month. Recurring recommendation cluster flag: Monday-start complete weeks, at least 5 unique valid dates, >0 runtime and sum(active h) / sum(runtime h) ≤ 20%. Server flag: unique complete weekly record with avg CPU ≤5%, peak CPU ≤20%, avg RAM ≤40% and uptime ≥120 h. Both need ≥3 qualifying weeks, ≥50% of observed weeks qualifying, and a hit in the last four complete weeks. Minimum coverage is 70% for clusters and 75% for servers. The separate licence flag needs positive unused seats in all last three complete Final months, grouped by provider, product, cost centre and file. Persistent unused seats use the minimum monthly gap. Findings screen for review. A measure uses its own pricing, scope and protection checks.
The detailed methodology and all 28 input roles are documented in docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
